daily_scan.notes: Tuesday scan, first run after yesterday's re-run touched all 48 umbrella files at once (setting last_checked=2026-09-21 on every one). Throttle rule (21+ days quiet AND last_checked <=2 KST days before today) applied against that shared baseline: 43 of 48 umbrellas were eligible to skip (all checked yesterday, all 25-831 days quiet on last_updated) and were skipped this run per the rule -- only 5 were due (quiet <21 days): ascendis-transcon-novo (8d), gsk-felcorekibart (14d) ascletis-asc30 (14d), samsung-bioepis-g2gbio-gb7001 (14d), owlbio-kyungdong-xtina (20d). All 5 single-alias breadth-queried (drug code/asset name first: TransCon Semaglutide, ASC30, Felcorekibart, AUL009, GB-7001) and all reconfirmed existing findings with no material new information -- gsk-felcorekibart's search surfaced two clinicaltrials.gov NCT numbers (NCT07780656/NCT07780669) for the already-logged PERSIST COPD-1/COPD-2 registrations, an enrichment of the existing Sept 8 finding rather than a new dated event, so no new finding was written. Track B1: 14/14 fixed watchlist rows queried; nothing new found among the four named-molecule classes. Code harvest surfaced 8 code-pattern strings (PT404, NN1706, MET-233, GSK5784283, HM17321, AZD6234, GUB014295/ABBV-295, DA-3091); PT404/NN1706/MET-233/GSK5784283/DA-3091 were already-tracked aliases or known decoys. Two unknown codes needed the two bounded queries: HM17321 (Hanmi) resolved as a Urocortin-2/CRF2-receptor muscle-preservation candidate, not an incretin/amylin molecule and no monthly-or-longer dosing disclosed -- a decoy, not queued; AZD6234 (AstraZeneca) resolved as a long-acting amylin analog but explicitly once-weekly dosed -- a decoy under the class baseline rule, not queued. 4 rotation-list rows queried (lilly-camurus, biote-cn121154792a, ct-g32, abbv-295), resuming after pt404 and wrapping to the start of the list; lilly-camurus and biote-cn121154792a reconfirmed existing documentation with nothing new; ct-g32 (Celltrion) progressed to primate toxicity testing (H1 2027 IND target) but still discloses no monthly-or-longer dosing interval, so it stays a watch-only rotation row, not a candidate; abbv-295 (AbbVie/Gubra long-acting amylin analog, on the rotation list as an untracked program since the watchlist was built) resolved into a new candidate, cand-2026-09-22-001 -- a Tier 1 AbbVie topline release (positive Phase 1 MAD data, 2026-03-09) plus a later Phase 2 dose-finding study registration clear all four promotion-bar conditions, so it was written directly as ready_for_promotion (fuzzy match to lilly-eloralintide 0.12, not a merge case). PROPOSAL for the admin: move 'abbv-295' out of the rotation list now that it is candidate cand-2026-09-22-001 (same treatment as 'alteogen-monthly' on 2026-09-21). B3 cheap pass (2/2 searches spent, priority: the never-checked cand-2026-09-20-001 first, then the oldest-created near_bar candidate last checked 2026-09-20, cand-2026-09-07-001): re-checked cand-2026-09-20-001 (Beijing Biote) -- same CN121154792A patent record, no new dated event; re-checked cand-2026-09-07-001 (Precision Antibiotics) -- same DKK 60M raise and two CarboCell G/C papers, no new dated event. Stall rule checked across all 15 pre-existing unresolved candidates (the new cand-2026-09-22-001 was created fresh via B1 and is not part of this count) -- oldest is 20 days old, none 30+, none triggered. Three domains returned EGRESS_BLOCKED this run on direct WebFetch (news.abbvie.com, www.gubra.dk, www.theglobeandmail.com), now logged under source_health as blocked; all other sources this run were reached via search only. patents.google.com and clinicaltrials.gov both reached via domain-scoped search again this run (search_only).

(tirzepatide long-acting liquid injection, filed 2025-10-24) -- queued as new candidate cand-2026-09-20-001; (3) conference accepted-abstract indices for ADA/EASD/ObesityWeek -- quiet for new programs (only already-tracked Mapi Pharma and G2GBio abstracts found, both already logged); (4) KIPRIS/USPTO/WIPO sustained-release/depot CPC sweep -- no new untracked program beyond the CN121154792A patent above; (5) full watchlist rotation list (6 rows: abbv-295, pt404, lilly-camurus, alteogen-monthly, biote-cn121154792a, ct-g32) -- all reconfirmed existing documentation, alteogen-monthly and biote-cn121154792a resolved into existing/new candidates as above, ct-g32 (Celltrion) still discloses no dosing interval so stays a watch-only rotation row; (6) all 13 Sunday-only rows (S1-S9 class/language variants, S10-S13 per-molecule clinicaltrials.gov) -- all quiet/reconfirming, matching the 2026-09-14 gap-test finding that these are structurally low-yield; (7) KOSDAQ 기술특례상장 pipeline -- no new LAI-specific entrant found, September remains off-season; (8) university tech-transfer / VC-deal-database sweep -- surfaced i2o Therapeutics, Inc. Code harvest across all B2 results surfaced no further unknown codes beyond CN121154792A. Track B3 weekly deep pass covered all 13 previously-unresolved candidates (one query each, see coverage.candidate_follow_up), prioritized near_bar first: cand-2026-09-02-004 (Alveus Therapeutics/ALV-100) escalated to ready_for_promotion -- this run pinned down citable URLs for its Jan 23, 2026 FDA IND clearance/first-patient-dosed event and its Feb 24, 2026 $197M Series A second closing, clearing confirmed_source and second_dated_event. cand-2026-09-02-002 (Samchundang) and cand-2026-09-07-001 (Precision Antibiotics) both newly cleared confirmed_source via independent corroborating sources found this cycle (still short of second_dated_event).
